brief:
Cairo will convene talks involving the Palestine Liberation Organisation, Palestinian Islamic Jihad, and Hamas, Middle East Eye reported. The gathering aims to address Palestinian unity and electoral matters, though specific dates and agendas were not disclosed in the initial report.

The talks represent a renewed diplomatic effort to bridge divisions among major Palestinian factions. Such negotiations have periodically stalled in recent years amid disagreements over governance and representation.
dek: Cairo to host Palestinian groups for talks on unity, elections, report says Cairo will host talks between Palestinian groups this week, including the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO), Palestinian Islamic Jihad (PIJ) and Hamas.
title: Cairo hosts Palestinian groups for unity and election talks
